dossier_meta.authors: Reed, Bruce A., Wood, David R.
dossier_meta.subject: Graph Theory » Basic Graph Theory » Minors
dossier_meta.statement_text: Conjecture Every graph with average degree at least $ \frac{4}{3}t-2 $ contains every 2-regular graph on $ t $ vertices as a minor.
dossier_meta.context_text: Reed and Wood [RW] explained that a result of Corradi and Hajnal [CH] implies that if $ H $ is the graph consisting of $ k $ disjoint triangles, then every graph with average degree at least $ 4k-2 $ contains $ H $ as a minor. Moreover, the bound of $ 4k-2 $ is best possible since the complete bipartite graph $ K_{2k-1,n} $ contains no $ H $ -minor, but has average degree tending to $ 4k-2 $ (as $ n\rightarrow\infty $ ). Thus the conjecture would generalise this result. Update: There has been a lot of recent progress on this conjecture [HW,CNLWY].
